snippet.title: Brawlhalla PS4 Founders Pack Trailer
snippet.description:
In the Brawlhalla Founders Pack for PS4 you get the following awesome things! 

- Instant access to the Brawlhalla beta 
- All Legends unlocked. Forever. 
- Founder's Insignia 
- Founder's Signet
- Personal Sentry IV

US PlayStation Store: bit.ly/usbhfp
EU PlayStation Store: bit.ly/eubhfp

Check out the official Founders Pack announcement here on the PlayStation Blog! 

https://blog.us.playstation.com/2017/07/27/brawlhalla-founders-pack-available-august-1-includes-all-future-fighters/


Website: http://www.brawlhalla.com
